slides.headline: GOOGLE JUST LAUNCHED GEMINI 3.8 TEXT-TO-SPEECH MODELS
slides.sub: This includes Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS.
slides.image_prompt: A group of diverse developers collaborating around a table, brainstorming ideas, with laptops open and notes scattered, in a bright, modern office space.

slides.headline: THESE MODELS OFFER CUSTOM CHARACTER VOICES FOR CREATORS
slides.sub: Generate voices for gaming, audiobooks, podcasts, and media.
slides.image_prompt: A close-up shot of a voice actor recording in a sound studio, surrounded by microphones and soundproofing, with focused expression.

slides.headline: GEMINI 3.8 FLASH TTS ENABLES CREATIVE CONTROL OVER VOICE ACTING
slides.sub: Direct performances with cues, pacing, and dialect shifts.
slides.image_prompt: A creative director interacting with a digital interface, adjusting audio settings, with an artist working in the background.

slides.headline: GEMINI 3.8 FLASH-LITE TTS IS OPTIMIZED FOR HIGH-VOLUME USE
slides.sub: Perfect for dubbing and audio content creation at scale.
slides.image_prompt: A busy editing room with multiple screens displaying audio waveforms, editors focused on their work, and sound equipment.

slides.headline: GEMINI 3.8 CAN CREATE AN INFINITE LIBRARY OF VOICES
slides.sub: This expands possibilities for personalized audio experiences.
slides.image_prompt: An abstract visualization of sound waves emanating from a central point, symbolizing creativity and innovation in audio technology.
